campaigns_page_description: Create and manage campaign records. Status is informational and budget is a planned amount, not spend.
campaigns_search: Search by name or source key
campaigns_budget_hint: Planned budget in SAR, not actual spend.
campaigns_empty_hint: Create a campaign to keep its name, source key, and planned budget.
campaigns_no_permission_view: You don't have permission to view campaigns.
campaigns_no_permission_create: You don't have permission to create campaigns.
campaigns_no_permission_edit: You don't have permission to edit campaigns.
campaigns_delete_confirm: Delete this campaign? Leads and reservations are not deleted.
campaigns_source_hint: Stable key for future mapping. Changing the display name does not change this key.
campaigns_status_hint: Informational only. Pausing or completing a campaign does not stop leads or bookings.
campaigns_source_warning: Changing the source key may affect future attribution. Existing leads and reservations are not updated.
campaigns_source_confirm_label: I understand, save the new source key
campaigns_source_confirm_required: Confirm the source key change before saving.
campaigns_source_taken: This source key is already used. A deleted campaign keeps its key reserved.
campaigns_source_server_confirm: Confirm the source key change before saving. Future attribution may be affected.
campaigns_date_order: The end date must be on or after the start date.
campaigns_budget_invalid: Enter a budget of zero or more, with up to 2 decimal places.
campaigns_name_too_long: Name must be 255 characters or fewer.
campaigns_source_too_long: Source key must be 255 characters or fewer.
campaigns_description_too_long: Description must be 5000 characters or fewer.
